exceptions.exposure: The vulnerable esbuild development-server capability is not exposed by Proprium runtime images or CI and is reached only through the locked tsx development toolchain.
exceptions.mitigation: Do not expose local development servers to untrusted networks or input. Remove this exception when tsx accepts a fixed esbuild release.

exceptions.exposure: The affected parser is present only in the Storybook development graph and processes repository-owned story assets during trusted builds.
exceptions.mitigation: Do not process untrusted ICNS, JXL, or HEIF assets through Storybook. Upgrade or replace the Next.js Storybook adapter when a fixed image-size path is available.
